decision: Set RUN_SERIAL TRUE only for test_standalone_app to isolate its existing 600 ms timing-sensitive smoke from concurrent software-raster CTests. Independent review and the next integrated run remain required.

observations.parallel_affected_result: 42/43; test_standalone_app failed three of 184 subprocesses in the 21-method suite
observations.first_failure: 1280x900 inactive T3 layout: only 3 rendered images; no smoke note-on sent
observations.remaining_failures: legacy state readers 1 and 3: same missed note-on window

isolated_result.purpose: Unchanged-byte isolated diagnostic following the retained 42/43 parallel affected run; not a replacement for its failures.

source_reason: advance_smoke sends note-on only after restore acknowledgment and while elapsed is at least 30 ms and below smoke_ms/2. Parallel CPU-heavy raster tests can starve the UI until after that window. The inactive-layout failure and unchanged-byte isolated pass support contention; they do not establish a real-device timing qualification.
limits: RUN_SERIAL isolates this CTest invocation only; it does not control unrelated host load or prove callback deadlines.
